shortDescription: Manage private automation hub execution environment remote registries

options.name: ah_host
options.description: URL to Ansible Automation Hub instance. If value not set, will try environment variable E(AH_HOST), or E(AAP_HOSTNAME). If value not specified by any means, the value of C(127.0.0.1) will be used.

options.name: ah_password
options.description: Password for your Ansible Automation Hub instance. If value not set, will try environment variable E(AH_PASSWORD), or E(AAP_PASSWORD).

options.name: ah_path_prefix
options.description: API path used to access the api. For galaxy_ng this is either V(automation-hub) or the custom prefix used on install with E(GALAXY_API_PATH_PREFIX). For Automation Hub this is V(galaxy).

options.name: ah_token
options.description: The Ansible Automation Hub API token to use. This value can be in one of two formats. A string which is the token itself. (for example, bqV5txm97wqJqtkxlMkhQz0pKhRMMX) A dictionary structure as returned by the ah_token module. If value not set, will try environment variable E(AH_API_TOKEN), or E(AAP_TOKEN).

options.name: ah_username
options.description: Username for your Ansible Automation Hub instance. If value not set, will try environment variable E(AH_USERNAME), or E(AAP_USERNAME).

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: A PEM encoded CA certificate used for authentication. Mutually exclusive with O(ca_cert_path).

options.name: ca_cert_path
options.description: Path to a PEM encoded CA certificate used for authentication. Mutually exclusive with O(ca_cert).

options.name: client_cert
options.description: A PEM encoded client certificate used for authentication. Mutually exclusive with O(client_cert_path).

options.name: client_cert_path
options.description: Path to a PEM encoded client certificate used for authentication. Mutually exclusive with O(client_cert).

options.name: client_key
options.description: A PEM encoded private key file used for authentication. Mutually exclusive with O(client_key_path).

options.name: client_key_path
options.description: Path to a PEM encoded private key file used for authentication. Mutually exclusive with O(client_key).

options.name: download_concurrency
options.description: Number of concurrent collections to download.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the registry to remove or modify.

options.name: password
options.description: The password to authenticate to the registry with.

options.name: proxy_password
options.description: Password for the username to use for the proxy connection.

options.name: proxy_url
options.description: Proxy URL to use for the connection.

options.name: proxy_username
options.description: Username to use for the proxy connection.

options.name: rate_limit
options.description: Limits total download rate in requests per second.

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the Automation Hub host. Defaults to 10 seconds, but this is handled by the shared module_utils code. If value not set, will try environment variable E(AAP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT)

options.name: state
options.description: If V(absent), then the module deletes the registry. The module does not fail if the registry does not exist because the state is already as expected. If V(present), then the module updates the description and README file for the registry.

options.name: tls_validation
options.description: Whether to validate TLS when connecting to the remote registry.

options.name: url
options.description: The URL of the remote registry. Required if O(state=present).

options.name: username
options.description: The username to authenticate to the registry with.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to allow insecure connections to Automation Hub Server. If V(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. If value not set, will try environment variable E(AH_VERIFY_SSL), or E(AAP_VALIDATE_CERTS).
